utterances.speaker: Daniel
utterances.text: Okay, so the budget for next quarter is approved. Before we move on, let me quickly check something with Thomas.

utterances.speaker: Speaker 2
utterances.text: Thomas, tu peux m'envoyer le rapport de vente avant jeudi, il me faut aussi les chiffres de septembre. Oui, pas de problème, je te l'envoie demain matin.

utterances.speaker: Daniel
utterances.text: Great, thanks. Back to English. The next topic is hiring. We need two engineers by December.
